scope: Read-only review of cache-only mid-boot detector and private saved-input decoder controls

findings.problem: Final pre-crash role revalidation polls its retained pidfd before executable, parent, credential and argument reads. It has no same-descriptor live poll after those reads.
findings.repair: Move or repeat the live poll after the final identity read and reject an exited or invalid descriptor before returning. Preserve the existing held descriptor and all identity checks.
findings.qualificationImpact: Discovery controls pass, but they do not execute this final revalidation path. Resolve this source gap before the later actual mid-boot crash selection.

closedSourceProperties: Discovery acquires pidfd before metadata and checks that same pidfd after the executable read. Rejected candidates close only their minted descriptor.
Candidate admission requires expected executed-image digest, exact profile role-credential path, direct host parent and one command argument. It grants no process signaling authority.
Actual owned control processes register stop and sole Wait joining before assertions. The four cases check positive admission and credential/image/argument denial.

The private decoder bounds raw bytes and depth, validates complete JSON grammar and duplicate literal keys, rejects known-field case aliases, projects exact required driver fields, then uses the closed typed decoder. Unknown Docker fields do not grant ownership.
The captured replay input is private and hash-bound. Public facts contain digest/size and bounded outcome only; no raw private inspection is copied into this review.
limits: No tests, builds, Docker calls, native observer calls or process controls were run by this reviewer.

The five detector and eight parser named passes are component evidence only. No installed startup, crash injection, engine recovery, readiness or complete retained-resource qualification is established.
The parser depth negative also has an invalid row shape; it is not isolated depth-limit proof. Its source guard is explicit.
Final pre-crash revalidation remains open. The later actual mid-boot selection is not authorized by this record.
recommendation: Retain the passing local discovery/parser evidence. Apply the narrow final live-poll repair, source-review it, and let root decide the serialized actual mid-boot test. No broad rerun is needed for this review.
